title.narrative: Supporting HIV response by reducing new infections and AIDS related morbidity and mortality - Rwanda (01-Jan-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Rwanda, HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Rwanda (Ministry of health)This program has the following goals: New HIV infections are reduced by 2020. HIV related deaths and comorbidities are reduced. People infected and affected by HIV have the same opportunities as the general population. The objectives of this program are: New infection in children are remained below 5% by 2020. New HIV infections by sexual transmission reduced. New HIV infections by sexual transmission reduced. Reduction of new HIV infection and hepatitis through blood borne transmission. The coverage of ART and the VL suppression among PLHIV on Treatment are increased. People living with HIV receive standardized adequate care and support. PLHIV have reduced morbidity related to STI, OI and other co-morbidities. People infected and affected by HIV and MVC have improved socio-economic status and protection. SGBV and HIV related stigma and discrimination are reduced
